text:
<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I have been living in this city for five years.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम एहि शहरमे पाँच वर्षसँ रहैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The harvest was good this year.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एहि वर्ष फसल नीक भेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My grandmother tells us stories every night.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर दादी हमरा सबकेँ रोज राति कथा सुनबैत छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The children are playing in the courtyard.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बच्चा सब आँगनमे खेलाइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please speak slowly, I do not understand.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया धीरेसँ बाजू, हमरा नहि बुझाइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I want to learn more about Mithila culture.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम मिथिलाक संस्कृतिक बारेमे आर जनबाक चाहैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The river flooded last year.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
पछिला वर्ष नदीमे बाढ़ आएल छल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: We celebrate Chhath Puja every year.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम सब हर वर्ष छठ पूजा मनबैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My uncle came from Delhi yesterday.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर चाचा काल्हि दिल्लीसँ आएल छलाह।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: This work will be done by evening.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई काज साँझ धरि भए जाएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I have not eaten anything since morning.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम भिनसरसँ किछु नहि खेलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: She is a very good teacher.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ बड्ड नीक शिक्षिका छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will finish this work and then rest.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई काज खतम कए तखन आराम करब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The old man was sitting under the tree.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बुजुर्ग लोक गाछ तरे बैसल छलाह।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My exam results came out today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ हमर परीक्षाक परिणाम आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I passed with first class.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम प्रथम श्रेणीसँ उत्तीर्ण भेलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: There is a lot of work at home today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ घरमे बहुत काज अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: He did not come to the meeting yesterday.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ काल्हि बैसारमे नहि आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The mango trees are full of fruit this season.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एहि मौसममे आमक गाछ फलसँ भरल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My village is very beautiful.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर गाम बड्ड सुंदर अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Can you speak Maithili?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँ मैथिली बाजि सकैत छी?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I speak Maithili at home.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम घरमे मैथिली बाजैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The festival begins next week.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
पर्व अगिला सप्ताहसँ शुरू होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: We made sweets for the festival.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
पर्वक लेल हम सब मिठाई बनेलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The guest arrived this morning.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
पाहुन आइ भिनसरे आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: We prepared a good meal for them.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हुनकर लेल नीक खाना बनेलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The road is very bad after the rain.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बर्खाक बाद रस्ता बड्ड खराब भए गेल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि हमरा अस्पताल जाएबाक अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The cow gives milk every morning.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
गाए रोज भिनसर दूध दैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My daughter stood first in class.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर बेटी कक्षामे प्रथम आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: We planted new trees in the garden.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम सब बगइचामे नव गाछ लगेलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: He has been working here for ten years.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ एतए दस वर्षसँ काज कए रहल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The school will remain closed tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि स्कूल बंद रहत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I bought a new mobile phone today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ हम नया मोबाइल कीनलहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The electricity went out last night.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि राति बिजली चलि गेल छल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please help me with this work.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया एहि कामे हमरा मदति करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will definitely come to your wedding.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम अहाँक बियाहमे जरूर आएब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The baby is sleeping peacefully.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बच्चा चैनसँ सुतल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My grandfather is ninety years old.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर दादाजी नब्बे वर्षक छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: He still walks two kilometers every day.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ एखनो रोज दू किलोमीटर चलैत छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am saving money to buy a house.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम घर कीनबाक लेल पैसा बचा रहल छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The pond near our village has dried up.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर गामक नजदीकक पोखरि सुखा गेल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: We must protect our language and culture.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमरा सबकेँ अपन भाषा आ संस्कृति बचेबाक चाही।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Vidyapati is the greatest poet of Maithili.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
विद्यापति मैथिलीक सबसँ महान कवि छलाह।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Mithila is known for its art and culture.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
मिथिला अपन कला आ संस्कृतिक लेल जानल जाइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am very happy to meet you.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँसँ भेँट भए बड्ड खुशी भेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please write your address here.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया एतए अपन पता लिखू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The letter arrived three days ago.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
चिट्ठी तीन दिन पहिने आएल छल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am thinking of starting my own business.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम अपन व्यापार शुरू करबाक सोचि रहल छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Hard work always pays off.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
मेहनत कखनो बेकार नहि जाइत अछि।
<end_of_turn>
